notes: The two new Dashboard cards from the last update (Service translation pipeline, Telegram channel queue) now sit side by side instead of stacked full-width, each with a proper 2x2 stat grid. Also fixed a real display bug found while doing this: their stat tiles were using responsive grid classes (sm:grid-cols-2, lg:grid-cols-4) that don't actually exist in this app's pre-built CSS bundle, so every tile had silently been stacking in a single column regardless of screen size since the last update shipped - switched to a plain unprefixed grid-cols-2, which is compiled and works.
